title: Sakina Jag Gaye Gi
body:
sakina jag gaye gi
sada zanjeer ki rukja
Patha baba ka puche gi
sada zanjeer ki rukja
1) Woo shab shame gareeban thi ye lashe baap tak pounchi
They ithne teer seene par lipat kar pao.n se soyi
Woo manzar yaad karle gi
sada zanjeer ki rukja
Sakina jag jaye gi.,
Sada zanjeer ki ruk ja..,
2) Jise shab ki namazo me mere baba ne maga tha
Usse din raat sine par kali ki thrha pala tha
Woo sina yaad karle gi
sada zanjeer ki ruk ja
Sakina jag jaye gi..
Sada zanjeer ki ruk ja....
3 ) adu durre bhi mare hain Tamache bhi lagaye hain
jo khud pahnaye they baba
woh bundo ko bhi chine hain
tadapkar phir se royegi
sada zanjeer ki ruk ja
Sakina jag jaye gi..sada zanjeer ki ruk ja
4)  pidar ka seena kiya choota abhi tak ye na soyi hai
Musibat par musibat hai bahut din se ye payassi hai
Ye uttkar pani mangegi
sada zanjeer ki ruk ja
Sakina jag jaye gi..
Sada zanjeer ki ruk ja
5) bhare bazar me is ko layino ne bulaya tha
Nabi zadi ko logoun ne kanizi me bhi manga tha
Owh saath yad aaye gi
sada zanjeer ki rukja
Sakina jag jaye gi
sada zanjeer ki ruk ja
6) barahna oont par kas kar sitamgaro.n ne bandha tha
Qadam aage jo bhadh te they lahu sine se bhe ta tha
woh gahra zakm dekhegi
Sada zanjeer ki rukja
Sakina jag jaye gi...
Sada zanjeer ki ruk ja....
7) utha jab baap ka saya yateemi chagai sar par
Masayab ke falaktoote qayamath girpadi sar par
Lahu ankhou'n se roo ye gi...
Sada zanjeer ki ruk la
Sakina jag jaye gi
Sada zanjeer ki ruk ja.
8) ateeq aghoosh mai.n bhayi ki
ye ab thak ke siyi hai
Kaha jazib ye aabid ne kayee ratho.n ki jagi hai
Ye phir aise na soye gi
sada zanjeer ki ruk ja
Sakina jag jaye gi
Sada zanjeer ki ruk ja..
